excerpts.intro: Use deepseek-flash as the model name. Legacy names ... requests are served by the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash model and billed at the Flash price.
excerpts.pricing: CONTEXT LENGTH 1M; per 1M tokens; Flash peak cache hit $0.006, cache miss $0.3, output $1.2. Product prices may vary.
excerpts.chat: max_tokens: total input + generated tokens limited by context length; 384K (393216). Last content chunk carries usage, then [DONE].
excerpts.usage: prompt_tokens equals prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens; cached_tokens same as cache hit; reasoning_tokens part of completion.
excerpts.counting: Approximate character ratios vary by model; actual usage comes from response. Linked tokenizer not explicitly bound to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash.
